message: No detected input validation: The code parses arguments and loads YAML task definitions but performs no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on incoming data.

No detected untrusted source handling: Pretrained models are referenced by name strings (e.g., 'bert-base-multilingual-cased') via HuggingFace Transformers with no pinned commits, checksums, or signature verification.

No detected label flipping detection: The code builds label vocabularies and maps label strings to integers but performs no distribution comparison, validation against an expected set, or label-noise detection (e.g., Cleanlab) to catch label-flipping anomalies.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or suspicious-input filtering is applied to the training samples anywhere in the visible data-preparation code.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads pretrained models via Hugging Face Transformers (e.g., 'bert-base-multilingual-cased') using string names/paths with no hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision specified anywhere in the visible code.

No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample detection before or during training; label vocab is built but not validated for distribution.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense present in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy library (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or related mechanism is imported or used anywhere in the training pipeline.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are referenced or invoked anywhere in the visible code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of hashed/signed evaluation data, isolated held-out test set enforcement, or multiple independent metric verification mechanisms in the visible code.
No detected input sanitization: No input validation, schema checks, shape/range guards, or rejection logic for malformed inputs is visible in the inference data-flow path.
No detected output bounds checks: No post-prediction checks such as probability sanity bounds, NaN guards, or calibrated threshold checks are present in the visible code.

No detected prompt injection defenses: Although the pipeline supports text-in models (BERT, T5, etc.), there is no input filtering, system-prompt isolation, output content moderation, or jailbreak detection logic anywhere in the visible code.
